div.div: How the database schema is created — versioned migration files run automatically when the service starts: one for the build tables (schema ais), one for the corpus tables (schema docuqa — 9 tables, indices, 2 triggers). Nobody creates tables by hand; a change is a new migration file, reviewed like code.
